title: Return History Addition - Credit Builder Accounts Early-Closure Returned-Fee Relief
content:
The relief share of the early-closure returned-fee relief on a Credit Builder account grows when the account has few other returned payments. "This one" is the account's most recent returned payment; the others are the account's remaining returned-payment entries, whatever their code, by their dates.

## Provision

When no payment on the account other than this one was returned in the 12 whole calendar months before today (a return dated today counts, and one dated on the same day of the month 12 months earlier falls outside them), the first-return addition is added; when exactly one other was, the second-return addition; when two or more were, nothing is added for return history.

| Other payments returned in the 12 months | Added to the relief share |
|---|---|
| none | first-return addition: 0.2 (20 percentage points) |
| exactly one | second-return addition: 0.1 (10 percentage points) |
| two or more | nothing |

## Edge of the 12 months (hypothetical dates)

Today 30 November: another return dated 30 November of the previous year falls outside; one dated 1 December of the previous year is counted.
